    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html,
    body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #9ddbe8;
    }

    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      touch-action: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    canvas:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    .hud {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      color: #f4fbff;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 30, 45, 0.45);
    }

    .title-card {
      position: absolute;
      top: 24px;
      left: 26px;
      max-width: min(430px, calc(100vw - 52px));
      padding: 18px 21px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
      border-radius: 15px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 35, 48, 0.82), rgba(8, 35, 48, 0.48));
      box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0, 25, 35, 0.2);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }

    .eyebrow {
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: #7ee3c1;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(23px, 4vw, 38px);
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .subtitle {
      margin-top: 9px;
      color: rgba(238, 250, 255, 0.72);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .controls {
      position: absolute;
      top: 24px;
      right: 26px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    button {
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      color: white;
      background: rgba(8, 35, 48, 0.72);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 25, 35, 0.18);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease;
    }

    button:hover {
      background: rgba(17, 67, 82, 0.9);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .hint {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 24px;
      left: 26px;
      padding: 10px 13px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: rgba(244, 252, 255, 0.82);
      background: rgba(8, 35, 48, 0.58);
      font-size: 12px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    .status {
      position: absolute;
      right: 26px;
      bottom: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 10px 13px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: rgba(244, 252, 255, 0.86);
      background: rgba(8, 35, 48, 0.58);
      font-size: 12px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    .status-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #7ee3c1;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px #7ee3c1;
    }

    #loading {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 10;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: white;
      background: #123a49;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: opacity 500ms ease;
    }

    #loading.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 650px) {
      .title-card {
        top: 14px;
        left: 14px;
        padding: 14px 16px;
      }

      .subtitle {
        display: none;
      }

      .controls {
        top: 14px;
        right: 14px;
      }

      .hint {
        left: 14px;
        bottom: 14px;
      }

      .status {
        right: 14px;
        bottom: 14px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div id="loading">Preparing workboat…</div>

  <div class="hud">
    <section class="title-card">
      <div class="eyebrow">Marine Operations / Vessel 04</div>
      <h1>TIDEWATCH 24</h1>
      <div class="subtitle">
        Coastal buoy tender · 24-meter working deck · articulated stern crane
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="controls">
      <button id="reset-view" type="button">Reset view</button>
    </div>

    <div class="hint">Drag to orbit · Scroll or pinch to zoom · Double-click to reset</div>

    <div class="status">
      <span class="status-dot"></span>
      <span>Crane cycle active · Aft deck ready</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05;
    document.body.prepend(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x9ddbe8);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x9ddbe8, 38, 125);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      43,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      250
    );

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xdff7ff, 0x173746, 2.1);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1cf, 3.1);
    sun.position.set(18, 28, 13);
    sun.castShadow = true;
    sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sun.shadow.camera.left = -24;
    sun.shadow.camera.right = 24;
    sun.shadow.camera.top = 24;
    sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -24;
    sun.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sun.shadow.camera.far = 70;
    sun.shadow.bias = -0.00025;
    scene.add(sun);

    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x8ed8ff, 0.7);
    fill.position.set(-15, 8, -12);
    scene.add(fill);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const materials = {
      hullRed: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xb93632,
        roughness: 0.48,
        metalness: 0.22
      }),
      hullWhite: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf2f0e7,
        roughness: 0.42,
        metalness: 0.18
      }),
      deck: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x303b3e,
        roughness: 0.82,
        metalness: 0.12
      }),
      darkMetal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x263238,
        roughness: 0.52,
        metalness: 0.72
      }),
      steel: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xaebbc0,
        roughness: 0.34,
        metalness: 0.82
      }),
      yellow: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf2b832,
        roughness: 0.42,
        metalness: 0.38
      }),
      orange: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf06b32,
        roughness: 0.48,
        metalness: 0.2
      }),
      glass: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x163d50,
        roughness: 0.18,
        metalness: 0.58,
        emissive: 0x071b25,
        emissiveIntensity: 0.35
      }),
      red: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xc83b32,
        roughness: 0.52,
        metalness: 0.16
      }),
      white: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf5f4eb,
        roughness: 0.55,
        metalness: 0.12
      }),
      black: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x172024,
        roughness: 0.62,
        metalness: 0.25
      }),
      rope: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xb99a62,
        roughness: 0.92
      }),
      wood: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x8b5f35,
        roughness: 0.86
      }),
      rust: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x8e4935,
        roughness: 0.78,
        metalness: 0.25
      })
    };

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Geometry helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function addBox(
      width,
      height,
      depth,
      material,
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      z = 0,
      parent = boat,
      castShadow = true
    ) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, height, depth),
        material
      );
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      mesh.castShadow = castShadow;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addCylinder(
      radiusTop,
      radiusBottom,
      height,
      material,
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      z = 0,
      parent = boat,
      segments = 16
    ) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
          radiusTop,
          radiusBottom,
          height,
          segments
        ),
        material
      );
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function cylinderBetween(
      start,
      end,
      radius,
      material,
      parent = boat,
      radialSegments = 10
    ) {
      const a = new THREE.Vector3(...start);
      const b = new THREE.Vector3(...end);
      const direction = b.clone().sub(a);
      const length = direction.length();

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
          radius,
          radius,
          length,
          radialSegments
        ),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addRailing(start, end, height = 1.05, radius = 0.035) {
      const a = new THREE.Vector3(...start);
      const b = new THREE.Vector3(...end);
      const length = a.distanceTo(b);
      const postCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(length / 1.15));

      for (let i = 0; i <= postCount; i++) {
        const p = a.clone().lerp(b, i / postCount);
        cylinderBetween(
          [p.x, p.y, p.z],
          [p.x, p.y + height, p.z],
          radius,
          materials.steel,
          boat,
          8
        );
      }

      cylinderBetween(
        [a.x, a.y + height, a.z],
        [b.x, b.y + height, b.z],
        radius,
        materials.steel,
        boat,
        8
      );
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Animated water
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const waterUniforms = {
      uTime: { value: 0 },
      uSunDirection: {
        value: new THREE.Vector3(-0.45, 0.8, -0.42).normalize()
      },
      uDeep: { value: new THREE.Color(0x17657c) },
      uShallow: { value: new THREE.Color(0x3aa6b5) },
      uFog: { value: new THREE.Color(0x9ddbe8) }
    };

    const waterMaterial = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: waterUniforms,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      vertexShader: `
        uniform float uTime;
        varying vec3 vWorldPosition;
        varying float vWave;
        varying vec3 vNormal;

        void main() {
          vec3 p = position;

          float waveA = sin(p.x * 0.43 + uTime * 0.85) * 0.20;
          float waveB = cos(p.z * 0.34 - uTime * 0.70) * 0.16;
          float waveC = sin((p.x + p.z) * 0.21 + uTime * 0.48) * 0.11;

          float h = waveA + waveB + waveC;

          float dx =
            cos(p.x * 0.43 + uTime * 0.85) * 0.20 * 0.43 +
            cos((p.x + p.z) * 0.21 + uTime * 0.48) * 0.11 * 0.21;

          float dz =
            -sin(p.z * 0.34 - uTime * 0.70) * 0.16 * 0.34 +
            cos((p.x + p.z) * 0.21 + uTime * 0.48) * 0.11 * 0.21;

          p.y += h;

          vWave = h;
          vNormal = normalize(vec3(-dx, 1.0, -dz));

          vec4 worldPosition = modelMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0);
          vWorldPosition = worldPosition.xyz;

          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * worldPosition;
        }
      `,
      fragmentShader: `
        uniform float uTime;
        uniform vec3 uSunDirection;
        uniform vec3 uDeep;
        uniform vec3 uShallow;
        uniform vec3 uFog;

        varying vec3 vWorldPosition;
        varying float vWave;
        varying vec3 vNormal;

        void main() {
          vec3 normal = normalize(vNormal);
          vec3 viewDirection = normalize(cameraPosition - vWorldPosition);

          float fresnel = pow(
            1.0 - max(dot(normal, viewDirection), 0.0),
            3.0
          );

          float depthMix = smoothstep(-0.35, 0.35, vWave);
          vec3 color = mix(uDeep, uShallow, depthMix * 0.75);

          vec3 reflectedLight = reflect(-uSunDirection, normal);
          float specular = pow(
            max(dot(reflectedLight, viewDirection), 0.0),
            120.0
          );

          float fineGlint = pow(
            max(dot(normal, viewDirection), 0.0),
            22.0
          );

          color += vec3(1.0, 0.92, 0.72) * specular * 2.0;
          color += vec3(0.35, 0.72, 0.82) * fineGlint * 0.22;

          float horizon = smoothstep(
            35.0,
            115.0,
            distance(cameraPosition, vWorldPosition)
          );

          color = mix(color, uFog, horizon);

          gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
        }
      `
    });

    const water = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(180, 180, 120, 120),
      waterMaterial
    );
    water.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    water.position.y = -0.02;
    scene.add(water);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Buoy tender hull
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const boat = new THREE.Group();
    boat.position.y = 0.05;
    scene.add(boat);

    const stations = [
      { z: -7.0, width: 1.45, bottom: -1.45 },
      { z: -6.0, width: 2.05, bottom: -1.60 },
      { z: -4.0, width: 2.25, bottom: -1.65 },
      { z:  0.0, width: 2.38, bottom: -1.65 },
      { z:  4.0, width: 2.28, bottom: -1.55 },
      { z:  6.0, width: 1.55, bottom: -1.15 },
      { z:  7.0, width: 0.08, bottom: -0.45 }
    ];

    function buildHullGeometry() {
      const positions = [];
      const colors = [];

      function triangle(a, b, c, color) {
        positions.push(...a, ...b, ...c);
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          colors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
        }
      }

      const lower = new THREE.Color(0xb93632);
      const upper = new THREE.Color(0xf2f0e7);

      for (const station of stations) {
        positions.push(
          -station.width, station.bottom, station.z,
          -station.width, 0.68, station.z,
           station.width, 0.68, station.z,
           station.width, station.bottom, station.z
        );
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < stations.length - 1; i++) {
        const a = i * 4;
        const b = (i + 1) * 4;

        // Port side.
        const pa = [positions[a], positions[a + 1], positions[a + 2]];
        const pb = [positions[a + 3], positions[a + 4], positions[a + 5]];
        const pc = [positions[b], positions[b + 1], positions[b + 2]];
        const pd = [positions[b + 3], positions[b + 4], positions[b + 5]];

        triangle(pa, pb, pc, lower);
        triangle(pa, pc, pd, upper);

        // Bottom.
        const rb = [positions[a + 3], positions[a + 6], positions[a + 7]];
        const rc = [positions[b + 3], positions[b + 6], positions[b + 7]];
        triangle(rb, rc, pa, lower);

        // Starboard side.
        const sa = [positions[a + 1], positions[a + 3], positions[a + 7]];
        const sb = [positions[b + 1], positions[b + 3], positions[b + 7]];
        triangle(sa, sb, pc, lower);
        triangle(sa, sd, sb, upper);

        // Top.
        const ta = [positions[a + 1], positions[a + 2], positions[a + 5]];
        const tb = [positions[b + 1], positions[b + 2], positions[b + 5]];
        triangle(ta, tb, ta[2], upper);
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "color",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3)
      );
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();

      return geometry;
    }

    const hull = new THREE.Mesh(
      buildHullGeometry(),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        vertexColors: true,
        roughness: 0.45,
        metalness: 0.24,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      })
    );
    hull.castShadow = true;
    hull.receiveShadow = true;
    boat.add(hull);

    // Non-slip deck.
    const deckShape = new THREE.Shape();
    deckShape.moveTo(0, 7);

    for (const station of stations) {
      if (station.width > 0.08) {
        deckShape.lineTo(station.width, station.z);
      }
    }

    deckShape.lineTo(0, -7);
    for (let i = stations.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const station = stations[i];
      if (station.width > 0.08) {
        deckShape.lineTo(-station.width, station.z);
      }
    }

    const deckGeometry = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(deckShape);
    deckGeometry.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);

    const deckMesh = new THREE.Mesh(deckGeometry, materials.deck);
    deckMesh.position.y = 0.70;
    deckMesh.receiveShadow = true;
    boat.add(deckMesh);

    // Bow cap.
    const bow = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.42, 16, 10),
      materials.hullWhite
    );
    bow.scale.set(0.75, 0.55, 1.6);
    bow.position.set(0, 0.57, 7.02);
    bow.castShadow = true;
    boat.add(bow);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Railings and deck fittings
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    addRailing([-2.1, 0.72, -6.25], [-2.1, 0.72, -2.75]);
    addRailing([ 2.1, 0.72, -6.25], [ 2.1, 0.72, -2.75]);
    addRailing([-2.1, 0.72,  2.35], [-2.1, 0.72,  6.45]);
    addRailing([ 2.1, 0.72,  2.35], [ 2.1, 0.72,  6.45]);
    addRailing([-1.48, 0.72, -6.7], [-0.48, 0.72, -6.7]);
    addRailing([ 0.48, 0.72, -6.7], [ 1.48, 0.72, -6.7]);

    // Deck edge rub rail.
    cylinderBetween(
      [-2.12, 0.72, -6.45],
      [-2.12, 0.72, -2.85],
      0.055,
      materials.darkMetal
    );
    cylinderBetween(
      [2.12, 0.72, -6.45],
      [2.12, 0.72, -2.85],
      0.055,
      materials.darkMetal
    );

    function addBollard(x, z) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      group.position.set(x, 0.72, z);
      boat.add(group);

      addCylinder(0.13, 0.18, 0.25, materials.darkMetal, 0, 0.12, 0, group);
      addCylinder(0.06, 0.09, 0.22, materials.darkMetal, 0, 0.31, 0, group);
      addCylinder(0.14, 0.14, 0.06, materials.darkMetal, 0, 0.43, 0, group);
    }

    addBollard(-1.65, -6.25);
    addBollard(1.65, -6.25);
    addBollard(-1.75, 5.8);
    addBollard(1.75, 5.8);

    // Life ring on the port bulwark.
    const lifeRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.38, 0.105, 12, 28),
      materials.orange
    );
    lifeRing.position.set(-1.57, 1.23, -6.35);
    lifeRing.castShadow = true;
    boat.add(lifeRing);

    const lifeRingBand = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.38, 0.025, 8, 28),
      materials.white
    );
    lifeRingBand.position.set(-1.57, 1.23, -6.35);
    boat.add(lifeRingBand);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Forward cabin
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    addBox(3.45, 1.85, 3.45, materials.hullWhite, 0, 1.68, 2.15);
    addBox(3.85, 0.18, 3.85, materials.white, 0, 2.68, 2.15);

    // Windshield.
    addBox(2.72, 0.78, 0.08, materials.glass, 0, 2.02, 3.91);
    addBox(0.08, 0.82, 2.15, materials.glass, -1.74, 2.02, 2.25);
    addBox(0.08, 0.82, 2.15, materials.glass, 1.74, 2.02, 2.25);

    // Door and handle.
    addBox(0.78, 1.55, 0.08, materials.hullWhite, 1.18, 1.62, 3.91);
    addBox(0.05, 0.28, 0.06, materials.darkMetal, 1.42, 1.72, 3.98);

    // Roof rail and mast.
    addRailing([-1.55, 2.72, 0.85], [-1.55, 2.72, 3.45]);
    addRailing([ 1.55, 2.72, 0.85], [ 1.55, 2.72, 3.45]);

    addCylinder(0.09, 0.13, 2.45, materials.steel, 0, 3.95, 2.15);
    addCylinder(0.035, 0.035, 1.4, materials.steel, 0, 5.12, 2.15);

    // Crossbars and radar.
    cylinderBetween(
      [-1.25, 4.68, 2.15],
      [ 1.25, 4.68, 2.15],
      0.045,
      materials.steel
    );

    const radar = new THREE.Group();
    radar.position.set(0, 2.83, 2.15);
    boat.add(radar);

    addBox(0.95, 0.16, 0.42, materials.white, 0, 0, 0, radar);
    addBox(0.12, 0.12, 0.12, materials.darkMetal, 0, 0, 0, radar);

    // Navigation lights.
    const portLightMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xff332f,
      emissive: 0xff160f,
      emissiveIntensity: 2.2
    });

    const starboardLightMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x35ff78,
      emissive: 0x16ff55,
      emissiveIntensity: 2.2
    });

    const sternLightMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      emissive: 0xd9f5ff,
      emissiveIntensity: 2.5
    });

    addBox(0.12, 0.18, 0.12, portLightMaterial, -1.88, 2.78, 2.15);
    addBox(0.12, 0.18, 0.12, starboardLightMaterial, 1.88, 2.78, 2.15);
    addBox(0.18, 0.18, 0.12, sternLightMaterial, 0, 2.78, 0.08);

    // Searchlights.
    for (const x of [-1.48, 1.48]) {
      const light = addCylinder(
        0.16,
        0.2,
        0.42,
        materials.darkMetal,
        x,
        2.02,
        4.08
